about_the_game:
The following content is included:

●Sticker Set: Monsters of the Windward Plains

These stickers capture the uniqueness of the monsters inhabiting the Windward Plains!
Enjoy communicating with your friends via chat!

*This content can be used from "Communication."
*Texts within Stickers can be entered/changed from "Sticker" under "Communication", by selecting "Edit Shoutout" in the sub menu.

*This product is also available as part of a set. Please be careful of duplicate transactions.
*You may need to update to the latest version of the game to use this content.
